message.content:
Now I can see the fuzzer allocates `out2` as 64 bytes (63 + 1) for `idn2_to_ascii_4i`. The vulnerability is that if the input contains a dot (U+002E), `idn2_lookup_u8` will process it as multiple labels and produce output longer than 63 characters, causing a buffer overflow in `strcpy`.

Let me look at the build script and submit script:

content:
./bootstrap
ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0 ./configure --enable-static --disable-shared --disable-doc --disable-gcc-warnings
make clean
make -j$(nproc) check
cd fuzz
make oss-fuzz
find . -name '*_fuzzer' -exec cp -v '{}' $OUT ';'
find . -name '*_fuzzer.dict' -exec cp -v '{}' $OUT ';'
find . -name '*_fuzzer.options' -exec cp -v '{}' $OUT ';'
for dir in *_fuzzer.in; do
  fuzzer=$(basename $dir .in)
  zip -rj "$OUT/${fuzzer}_seed_corpus.zip" "${dir}/"
done
